description: LIVE Amazon offers for one product: every seller offering it right now, read from Amazon's 'All offers' view at request time (every page). Each offer has the seller and seller id, price, shipping, condition, buy box, FBA / FBM / Amazon, Prime, ships-from, the delivery promise and the seller's feedback; the answer adds the buy-box winner, offer counts by fulfillment, whether Amazon sells it, and the lowest new and used prices. Use when the user asks who sells a product right now, the current buy-box winner, the cheapest offer, or needs a fresh seller list before buying, sourcing or repricing. For history use product_dossier or asin_buybox_history. Takes 4-12 seconds. Amazon marketplaces only.

asin.description: 10-character Amazon ASIN. Provide asin or barcode.

barcode.description: UPC / EAN / GTIN / ISBN-13 instead of an ASIN.

include_used.description: Also list used, refurbished and collectible offers.

marketplace_id.description: 1 = Amazon UK, 2 = Amazon US (default), 4 = Amazon CA, 5 = Amazon AU, 6 = Amazon DE, 7 = Amazon JP, 8 = Amazon IT, 9 = Amazon FR, 10 = Amazon ES, 11 = Amazon MX, 12 = Amazon BR. Amazon only.

zip.description: US 5-digit ZIP: the offers as a shopper at that ZIP sees them (Amazon US only; first page of offers).

name: live_offers
